gaps.gap: The BITU exit sold the whole position, which matches fraction 1.0. NBIS, CIFR and IREN were red-team failures and were cut in half, so a failed thesis now trims 0.5. DRAM had no company report and was also cut in half, so a named trim with no ACH or red-team result is unconfirmed and uses 0.5. A thesis that still stands trims 0.25.
